[RBND.2.3] **Forensic inline values.** Containers that carry the
RT-config binding MUST also carry the resolved RT configuration
values inline alongside the hash. The hash is the binding
comparator; the inline values are for human/forensic
readability when the producing profile is no longer available.
The inline values MUST exactly equal the values used to compute
`rt_config_sha256` per [RBND.4b]; a mismatch between inline
values and recomputed hash is `DS_ERR_BND_INCOMPLETE`.
